_source: Germany, 16 Laender = the 16 game regions (DE1 to DEG). upper_secondary_school: units = schools, capacity = enrolled pupils (not places: no body publishes places), school year 2025/26, Statistisches Bundesamt (Destatis), Statistischer Bericht 'Allgemeinbildende Schulen' (21111, file statistischer-bericht-allgemeinbildende-schulen-2110100267005.xlsx, tables 21111-01, -03, -18) and 'Berufliche Schulen und Schulen des Gesundheitswesens - Grunddaten' (21121, file statistischer-bericht-berufliche-schulen-2110200267005.xlsx, tables 21121-01, -02, -11), public and private. The set of school types is the one that is upper secondary in every Land: Gymnasien (units = all Gymnasien; capacity counts only their Sekundarbereich II pupils, because a Gymnasium also teaches lower secondary), Fachgymnasien, Fachoberschulen, Berufsoberschulen/Technische Oberschulen (Bayern reports no Fachgymnasien; it has Fach- and Berufsoberschulen instead) and Teilzeit-Berufsschulen (the school half of the dual apprenticeship, the counterpart of the French lycee professionnel); Teilzeit-Berufsschule pupils attend part of the week, so they weigh about 58% of the capacity in headcount terms, not in seat terms; capacity (Sekundarbereich II pupils of Gymnasien) and the pupils_per_teacher numerator (all their pupils) are different bases. Berufsfachschulen, Fachschulen, Fachakademien and the prevocational years are left out. Mecklenburg-Vorpommern's Gymnasium teachers are filed under 'Gymnasien (G8)' and are read from there. upper_secondary_pupils_per_teacher: all pupils of those school types (every grade) over their teachers, headcount of full- and part-time teachers (Destatis publishes no full-time equivalents in these tables); a school type with no teacher figure in a Land (Brandenburg's Fachgymnasien and Fachoberschulen, Rheinland-Pfalz's Fachoberschulen, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern's Fachoberschulen) is left out of the level only, not out of the stock. hospital: units = hospitals (Krankenhaeuser) and capacity = set-up beds (aufgestellte Betten) per Land in 2025, Destatis, Statistischer Bericht 'Grunddaten der Krankenhaeuser - Bundeslaender' (file statistischer-bericht-grunddaten-krankenhaeuser-bundeslaender-2120611257005.xlsx, table 23111-b02, Destatis's own sheet; its csv sheet omits Sachsen-Anhalt and is not used). hospital_beds_per_1000 = the same table's beds per 100 000 inhabitants over 100 (Destatis's population base), its Deutschland row for the national value. The catalogue's capacity for a hospital is the mean of the general hospitals (Allgemeine Krankenhaeuser, table 23111-b14: 420 922 beds in 1 452 hospitals = 290). Self-checks: the 16 Laender sum to Destatis's Deutschland rows for every school type (schools 6 485, pupils 2 236 577 with the Gymnasium Sekundarbereich II count, teachers) and to the national 1 807 hospitals and 468 803 beds. Each type's `figures` entry is its own figure from one table and one scope: `national` for upper_secondary_pupils_per_teacher is the 16 Laender's pupils over their teachers (15.08) and for hospital_beds_per_1000 the Deutschland row (5.61); the levels weighted by the regions' `share` give those back within 0.1 % (the loader's tolerance is 3 %).
